`create_model` computes `flat_snapshots` and uses it to flatten `n.model.parameters`, but it never converts `sns` itself from the MultiIndex returned by `as_index`. Consequently, with `"flat"` (or `"auto"` under v1 semantics), it still passes MultiIndex snapshots to the variable and constraint builders, including both loss-constraint branches; the component-data context does not change those arguments.
